tei:div.tei:p: (cha)༄༅// dpal rdo rje sems dpa' he ru ka'i bsgom bzlas yan lag dang bcas pa byin rlabs zla zhun gyi chu bo zhes bya ba bzhugs so// ༄༅// zla shel ltar dkar mi shigs yi ge las// byung ba'i chu bos sgrib pa'i dri 'khrud pa'i// dpal ldan bla ma snyems ma'i bdag po la// gus pas btud de zab mo'i gdams pa spel// 'dir dpal 'khor lo bde mchog gi bshad pa'i rgyud a bhi dha na las lha sngags bstan pa/ grub pa brgyud pa'i man ngag gis bkral ba'i dpal rdo rje sems dpa' he ru ka'i sgom bzlas nyams su blang ba'i tshul ni/ kye rdo rje/ 'khor lo bde mchog sogs ma rgyud kyi nyams len rgyun ldan du yod na/ de dag gi sngon 'gro'i skabs su 'byung ba la gnad du bsnun pas don 'grub cing*/ zur du byed na sngon 'gro ni/ bla med spyi ltar gyi skyabs 'gro gang mang dang*/ sems can thams cad kyi don du rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang thob par bya/ de'i ched du dpal rdo rje sems dpa'i sgom bzlas nyams su blang bar bgyi'o// zhes lan gsum gyis sems bskyed/ bsdu na sangs rgyas chos tshogs ma'am/ 'gro rnams bsgral 'dod sogs skyabs sems sbrags ma thun mong bas kyang rung*/ dngos gzhi la gsum las dang po lha bsgom pa ni/ rang gi spyi bor pad+ma dang zla ba'i steng du/ skad cig gis bcom ldan 'das rdo rje sems dpal he ru ka sku mdog dkar po zhal gcig phyag gnyis kyis rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pas yum la 'khyud pa/ rus pa'i rgyan drug gis brgyan pa/ zhabs rdo rje'i skyil mo krung gis bzhugs pa/ rang 'dra'i rigs bdag gi dbu rgyan can/ de'i pang na yum rdo rje snyems ma sku mdog dkar mo gri gug thod pa 'dzin pa/ phyag rgya lngas brgyan pa dang mnyam par sbyor ba zhes pas bskyed/ 'phags pa rin po ches rdo rje'i cho ga gsum las bskyed pa sogs gsungs kyang*/

rje btsun chen pos skad cig gis bskyed pa 'di bzhin gsungs shing dbu rgyan rang chas su bsgom pa ni mngon rtogs bsdus pa'i thob thang yin/ gnyis pa sngags bzla ba ni/ yab kyi thugs kar zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du hūm̐ dkar po de las 'od 'phros pas/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi thugs kyi snying po ye shes kyi bdud rtsi spyan drangs nas hūm̐ la thim/ bcom ldan 'das bdag dang sems can thams cad kyi 'khor ba thog ma med pa nas bsags pa'i sdig sgrib nyes ltung dri ma'i tshogs thams cad byang zhing dag par mdzad du gsol/ hūm̐ las bdud rtsi babs/ he ru ka'i sku gang*/ de nas dbyibs brgyud/ yum gyi sku gang*/ yab yum gyi sku thams cad las bdud rtsi babs/ bdag gi spyi gtsug nas zhugs pas nad gdon sdig sgrib thams cad dud khu'am rnag khrag gi rnam pas bshang gci gnyis dang*/ rkang mthil gnyis nas 'thon nas shul thams cad bdud rtsis gang bar gyur/ oṃ shrī

rdo rje khrag 'thung dam tshig rjes su skyong*/ badz+ra he ru ka sa ma ya ma nu pā la ya/ he ru khrag 'thung nyid kyis nye bar gnas par mdzod/ ka twe no pa tiṣ+ṭha/ ḍṛ ḍho me bdag la brtan par mdzad du gsol/ bha wa/ su to ṣ+yo me bdag la shin tu dges par mdzod/ bha wa/ a nu rak+to me bdag la rjes su chags par mdzod/ bha wa/ su po ṣ+yo me bha bdag la shin tu rgyas par mdzod/ wa/ sarba sid+dhim+me pra bdag la dngos grub thams cad stsol/ yats+tsha/ sarba karma su tsa las kun la yang bdag gi ni/ me/ tsit+taṃ shre yaḥku ru sems la dge legs su ni mdzod/ hūm̐/ ha ha ha ha hoḥ bha bcom ldan rdo rje khrag thung du/ ga wān/ badz+ra he ru ka mā me muñtsa bdag grol khrag 'thung nyid du mdzod/ he ru ko bha wa/ ma hā sa ma dam tshig sems dpa' chen po āḥ ya sa twa āḥhūm̐ phaṭa/ ces pa grangs ji tsam mang na legs mod/ nyung mthar yang nyi shu rtsa gcig re bzla dgos te/ slob dpon 'jam dpal grags pas/ yi ge brgya pa cho ga bzhin// nyi shu rtsa ni re re bzlas// ltung sogs byin gyis brlab 'gyur bas// 'phel ba ru ni mi 'gyur zhes// grub pa mchog rnams kyis bshad pas// thun mtshams su ni spyad par bya// 'bum phrag dag ni bzlas gyur na// rnam par dag pa'i bdag nyid 'gyur// zhes gsungs pas so// gsum pa bshags bsdom bya ba ni/ stobs bzhi'i go ba spyi ltar btsal nas thal mo sbyar te/ bdag ni mi shes rmongs pa ste// dam tshig las ni 'gal zhing nyams// bla ma mgon pos skyabs mdzod cig /gtso bo rdo rje 'dzin pa ste// thugs rje chen po bdag nyid can// 'gro ba'i gtso la bdag skyabs mchi// sku gsung thugs rtsa ba dang yan lag gi dam tshig nyams pa thams cad mthol lo bshags so// sdig pa dang sgrib pa nyes pa dang ltung ba dri ma'i tshogs thams cad byang zhing dag par mdzad du gsol/

zhes gsol ba btab pas/ rdo rje sems dpa' yab yum dges te/ rigs kyi bu khyod kyi sdig pa dang sgrib pa thams cad dag par byas yod do// zhes gsung bzhin pas 'od du zhu/ spyi bo nas rang la thim pas rang gi lus 'ja' tshon lta bur gyur par bsams la/ rdor sems dang rang sems dbyer med du 'dres pa'i gsal stong rang rig brjod pa dang bral ba'i ngang la mnyam par bzhag rjes ni/ 'od gsal de las rang nyid rdo rje sems dpa' kha sbyor sgyu ma'i sku can du langs la/ dge ba 'di yis myur du bdag /rdo rje sems dpa' 'grub 'gyur nas zhes sogs bsngo smon gyi rgyas gdab bo// bsnyen pa byed na/ gnas dben par spros pa bcad/ phyi nang gi bcad rgya srung 'khor sogs rang gi yi dam gang yin gyi gzhung ltar byas la/ ngag 'don gong ltar las thun bzhi'am gsum du bcad de yig brgya 'bum phrag bzhi'am/ rtags ma byung gi bar du bzla/ bzlas pa'i tshe dmigs pa dkyus bzhin nam/ gsung sgros khyad par ba ltar na/ thog mar bdud rtsi dkar po cung zad tsha ba'i rnam pa can gyis grang ba'i nad thams cad rnag khrag ljan ljin 'ja' tshon sngo dmar gyi rnam pa can du ded cing sbyang*/ de nas bdud rtsi shin tu bsil ba'i rang bzhin can gyis tsha ba'i nad thams cad sngar bzhin sbyang*/ de nas bdud rtsi snum bag dang ldan pas rlung gi nad thams cad sbyang*/ yang bdud rtsi tsha ba'i rnam pa can gyi khrod na rta mgrin/ phyag rdor bdud rtsi 'khyil pa sogs khro chung gi rdul phran 'dres pas gdon thams cad sbal sbrul/ sdom sdig sogs srog chags kyi rnam pa can du ded cing sbyang*/ de nas bdud rtsi dkar po bde ba chen po'i rang bzhin gyis sdig sgrib nyes ltung thams cad dud khu dang sol khu'i rnam pa can du ded cing lus sems bde bas gang bar bsam pa 'di la gtso bor bya/ thun mthar bdud rtsi smin mtshams yan chad du brtan pas bum pa'i dbang thob lus kyi dri ma dag

sku'i dam tshig nyams pa sor chud/ rdor sems yab yum gyi sku'i byin rlabs zhugs/ 'bras bu sprul sku 'grub pa'i skal ba can du byas snyam du bsam/ de nas rim gyis bab mgrin par brtan pas/ gsang ba'i dbang thob/ ngag gi dri ma dag gsung gi dam tshig nyams pa sor chud/ gsung gi byin rlabs zhugs/ 'bras bu longs sku 'grub pa'i skal ba can du byas snyam du bsam/ snying gar brtan pas shes rab ye shes kyi dbang thob/ yid kyi dri ma dag thugs kyi dam tshig nyams pa sor chud/ thugs kyi byin rlabs zhugs/ 'bras bu chos sku 'grub pa'i skal ba can du byas snyam du bsam/ lus thams cad khyab cing brtan pas dbang bzhi pa thob/ sgo gsum gyi dri ma bag chags dang bcas pa dag rtsa ba dang yan lag gi dam tshig nyams pa mtha' dag sor chud/ byin rlabs dngos grub thams cad thob cing brtan par byas/ 'bras bu ngo bo nyid kyi sku 'grub pa'i skal ba can du byas par bsams la/ stobs bzhi'i go ba spyi ltar gyis bshags sdom sogs la 'jug mnyam gzhag gi skabs su/ rdo rje mi phyed ces byar brjod// sems dpa' srid pa gsum gcig pa// zhes gsungs pa ltar rang sems kyi chos nyid spros pa'i mtha' thams cad dang bral ba mtshan rtog gis gzhar yang mi phyed pa ni rdo rje/ de nyid kyi chos can thams cad la khyab pas srid pa gsum po sgyu ma'i snang bar ro gcig pa ni sems dpa' ste/ khyab bya khyab byed kyi go bas gnas lugs don gyi rdo rje sems dpa' rang ngo shes par byas la yun gang ring du skyong ba gnad du che ste/ thar pa chen po phyogs su rgyas pa'i mdo las kyang*/ drang por 'dug la yang dag ltos// yang dag nyid la yang dag blta// yang dag mthong na rnam par grol// de ni 'gyod tshangs mchog yin no// zhes gsungs pa dang don gcig la/ bshags bya bshags byed dang bral ba la don dam pa'i bshags par bzhed do// bsnyen pa'i rtags ni/

dngos su lus yang ba/ rig pa dwangs pa/ blo chos la bkol du btub pa/ sngar med pa'i nyams dang go ba skye ba sogs mthun pa'i phyogs dang*/ sngar med pa'i dgra dang nad gzhi ldang ba dang*/ longs spyod gud pa sogs mi mthun pa'i rkyen glo bur du langs na'ang dge sbyor gyi rtags su thag bcad dgos shing*/ lha sngags kyi byin rlabs dang*/ sngon las 'dag pa'i snga ltas su nges te/ thub pa'i dbang pos bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i gnas du mar bka' stsal pa/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i mthu dang*/ las kyi rnam par smin pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa gnyis snang bas so// tha na'ang rmi lam du lus las srog chags dang ngan skyugs thon pa/ khrus byas pa/ gos dkar po gyon pa/ nam mkha' la 'phur ba sogs rmi ba'o// thun mtshams rnams su phyag dang bskor ba/ byang chub ltung bshags sogs sme bshags kyi rigs la 'bad/ mtshams grol khar yi dam gyi gtso bo gang yin gyi gzhung bsrang ba'i tshogs 'khor ram/ dpa' bo'i ston mo/ yi dam gyi bka' sdod gang yin pa de'i gtor sgrub dang 'brel ba'i 'khon gcugs sbyong ba'i bzlas pa bshags skong bcas bya/ bsnyen pa'i mjug gam gnas skabs gzhan du ni sbyin sreg byed na kho bos byas pa'i dam tshig rdo rje'i sbyin sreg ji lta ba bzhin la/ mi 'dra ba'i khyad par/ thab dbus kyi mtshan ma rdo rje dkar po'am tshon phung dkar po bya/ 'das pa'i me lha bskyed pa'i skabs su/ me 'bar ba'i dbus su pam̐ las pad+ma dang a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du hūm̐ las rdo rje dkar po hūm̐ gis mtshan pa/ de las 'od zer 'phros pas sems can thams cad kyi sdig sgrib sbyang*/ tshur 'dus rdo rje la thim/ de yongs su gyur pas las bcom ldan 'das rdo rje sems dpa' dpal he ru ka sku mdog dkar po/ zhal gcig phyag gnyis kyis rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pas yum la 'khyud pa/ rus pa'i rgyan drug gis brgyan pa/

zhabs rdo rje'i skyil mo krung gis bzhugs pa/ de'i pang na yum rdo rje snyems ma dkar mo gri gug thod pa 'dzin pa/ phyag rgya lngas brgyan pa dang mnyam par sbyor ba/ de gnyis ka'i dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ thugs kar hūm̐/ rang gi thugs ka'i hūm̐ las sogs nas chu'i lhag ma yar lud pa las rang 'dra'i rdo rje sems dpas dbur brgyan zhes dang*/ gong 'og gi mtshan thams cad bcom ldan 'das rdo rje sems dpa' zhes dang*/ mtshan sngags oṃ bha ga wān ma hā kā ru ṇi ka badz+ra satwa sa pa ri wā ra zhes bsgyur/ don yod rgyal po sogs kyi tshab tu/ 'gro ba'i me shes gcod pa can// dag pa'i de nyid don ston mdzad// bdag med chos las byung ba yi// rdo rje sems dpar phyag 'tshal bstod// ces rgya gzhung 'ga' re nas 'byung bas bstod/ lha sngags thams cad yig brgyas bya zhing bstod pa rgyas pa mnyam nyid mas bya ba sogs dkyus ltar ro// rang gzhan gyi don du bum chog byed na/ bum pa spyi ltar bcas pa'i mthar mchod pas bskor/ bdag bskyed sbyin sreg gi skabs bzhin nam/ kye rdor sogs sam thun mtshams kyi lhar dran tsam gyis bum pa bsang sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las pam̐ las pad+ma a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du bh+rūm̐ las rin po che'i bum pa mtshan nyid thams cad yongs su rdzogs pa/ lha'i gos kyi mgul chings dang*/ dpag bsam gyi shing gis kha brgyan pa/ nang chu dang bcud thams cad kyis gang ba'i dbus su pam̐ las pad+ma dang a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor sogs nas rdo rje sems dpas dbur brgyan/ mchod pa bla med spyi ltar byin gyis brlab/ mtshan sngags re re bzhin sbyar ba'i chu gnyis nyer spyod/ rol mor bcas pa'i phyi mchod dang*/ mtshan sngags la oṃ āḥhūm̐ btags pas nang mchod dbul/ 'gro ba'i mi shes gcod pa can sogs kyi bstod/ rang gi snying ga nas sngags kyi phreng ba gzungs thag la brten te song ba bum nang gi lha'i thugs kar phog pas thugs rgyud bskul/

sku las bdud rtsi'i rgyun babs pas bum pa gang bar bsam zhing gzungs thag la 'jus te yig brgya mang du bzla/ mthar sngar bzhin mchod bstod byas la/ bcom ldan 'das la bdag dang sems can thams cad kyi tshe 'khor ba thog ma med pa nas bsags pa'i sdig sgrib nyes ltung dri ma'i tshogs thams cad byang zhing dag par byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ mchog dang thun mong gi dngos grub ma lus pa stsal du gsol/ zhes gsol ba gdab/ ma 'byor pa dang sogs kyis bzod par gsol/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ mchod yon phul ba'i rkyen gyis lha 'od du zhu ba las bum pa'i chu bdud rtsi'i rang bzhin can du gyur/ ces brjod/ bum chog rdo rje mkha' 'gro'i rgyud la brten pa zhig kyang yod mod/ thun mong du grags pa'i lha sngags 'di bzhin bskyed bzlas byas na 'gal ba med snyam zhing spyi khyab tu 'jug bde bar mngon no// yang glo bur du mchod pa sogs med par sgrub dgos na/ bum pa la gzungs thag cig btags nas bsang sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las sogs nas gang ba'i dbus su zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du hūm̐ dkar po'i mthar yi ge brgya pa'i sngags mu tig gi phreng ba lta bus bskor ba lha dang dbyer med du bsam/ rang gi snying ga nas sngags kyi phreng ba gzungs thag la brten te song ba bum nang gi sngags phreng la phog de las bdud rtsi'i rgyun babs pas sogs sngar bzhin la/ mthar sngags phreng gdan dang bcas pa 'od du zhu nas/ bum pa'i chu dang gnyis su med par gyur/ zhes brjod/ rang don yin na tho rang khrus kyi rnal 'byor rang rang gi gzhung bzhin bya ba'am/ thun mtshams gzhan du'ang yig brgya bzla zhing khrus bya/ khong du btung*/ dmigs pa bla ma dang dbyer med pa'i he ru kas spyi bo nas khrus byas par bsam pa las 'don bya gang yang mi dgos so// gzhan la byed na/ bsgrub bya mdun du 'khod pa la/ dmigs pa'i brda sprod ni/

slob dpon he ru kar gsal ba'i phyag na rin po che'i bum pa ye shes kyi bdud rtsi bde ba chen po'i rang bzhin dkar bsil zla shel zhu ba'i khu ba lta bus gang ba thogs pa'i chu rgyun gyis spyi bo nas khrus byas pas lus kyi nang gang nas 'khor ba thog ma med pa nas bsags pa'i sdig pa dang sgrib pa/ nad gdon nyer 'tshe/ sdom pa 'og ma'i bcas 'gal/ khyad par du rig pa 'dzin pa'i sdom pa dang dam tshig gi nyes ltung dri ma'i tshogs thams cad dud khu dang rnag khrag srog chags mi sdug pa sogs kyi rnam pas bshang gci'i lam dang rkang mthil gnyis nas 'thon te shul thams cad bdud rtsis gang ba la brten nas lus sems thams cad zag pa med pa'i bde ba chen pos khyab pa'i mos pa mdzod/ ces dang*/ bum pa thogs te dril bu gsil zhing*/ ji ltar bltams pa sogs dang*/ 'di ni khrus mchog sogs dang*/ 'di ni sbyin pa'i rang bzhin chu sogs sh+lo ka drug ste de rnams re re'i mthar yig brgya dang*/ chu bo drug gis sogs sh+lo ka gsum gyi mthar yig brgya dang*/ 'dod chags zhe sdang gti mug sogs tshigs bcad gsum gyi mthar yig brgya dang*/ sa 'di dug gi pha yin te zhes sogs bzhi'i mthar yig brgya brjod cing khrus byas pa'i mthar/ rdo rje slob ma 'di'i tshe thog ma med pa nas bsags pa'i mi dge ba bcu dang*/ mtshams med pa/ nye ba'i mtshams med pa la sogs pa rang bzhin gyi sdig pa las dang nyon mongs pa'i sgrib pa dang bcas pa thams cad shān+tiṃ ku ru swā hā/ so thar dang byang sems kyi bslab bya dang 'gal ba thams cad shān+tiṃ ku ru swā hā/ gsang ba sngags kyi rtsa ba dang yan lag gi dam tshig dang 'gal ba thams cad shān+tiṃ ku ru swā hā/ mnyam gzhag dang rjes spyod kyi dam tshig dang 'gal ba thams cad shān+tiṃ ku ru swā hā/ bza' ba dang*/ bsrung ba dang*/ mi 'bral ba'i dam tshig dang 'gal ba thams cad shān+tiṃ ku ru swā hā/

mchod gtor dman zhing bsnyen sgrub g.yel bas mkha' 'gro chos skyong gi thugs dang 'gal ba thams cad shān+tiṃ ku ru swā hā/ gang zag gi sa mtshams ma phyed pas srung mtshams 'chol ba thams cad shān+tiṃ ku ru swā hā/ gnas dang grogs la sogs pa'i grib ma thams cad shān+tiṃ ku ru swā hā/ de rnams kyi rkyen gyis nad dang gdon dang*/ sdug bsngal dang*/ bying rgod kyi dbang du gyur pa thams cad shān+tiṃ ku ru swā hā/ zhes brjod/ de nas byabs srung spyi ltar bya ba'am shis brjod ji ltar rigs par byas la/ rang gnas su btang*/ rjes chog gang yang mi dgos so// khrus kyi skabs su tshigs bcad mang po 'don mi thub na/ ji ltar bltams pa sogs sh+lo ka gcig dang*/ yig brgya mang du brjod pa'i mthar rdo rje slob ma 'di'i sogs sbrel bas 'thus so// a bhi dha nar gsungs pa'i 'khrul 'khor gyis phyir zlog pa'i las ni zla ba mar ngo la/ shog bu gtsang mar skyes pa srung na gur gum gi waṃ dang*/ bud med srung na rgya skyegs kyis 'khor lo lte ba ji ltar 'tsham par bskor ba'i mthar mu khyud dang*/ de'i phyi rol du rtsibs bcu drug mu khyud dang bcas pa bri/ lte bar oṃ āḥhūm̐ ming 'di zhes bya ba la rak+ṣa rak+ṣaḥ zhes pa dang*/ rtsibs bcu drug la yi ge brgya pa tshan pa bcu drug tu bcad pa yig mgo phyir bstan du bri/ mu khyud nang ma la ā li g.yon skor dang*/ phyi ma la kā li g.yas skor du bri/ 'di gnyis ka'i 'gor oṃ dang mthar hūm̐ phaṭa sbyar ba yin nam snyam ste/ bde mchog gi skabs su bri bzlas gnyis kar de bzhin yod pa shas che zhing*/ 'og gi rab gnas kyang shes/ rab gnas ni/ 'khor lo de thod pa'am zangs gzhong nas kyis bkang ba'i steng du bzhag nyer spyod lnga dang*/ gtor ma gsum bsham/ rang lha'i nga rgyal gyis swa bhā wa'i sngags lan gsum brjod pas stong par sbyang*/ de'i ngang las pam̐ las pad+ma dang a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du hūm̐ las 'khor lo rtsibs bcu drug pa lte ba dang*/

mu khyud phyi nang la bkod pa'i yi ge rnams dang bcas pa bris pa'i rnam pa ji lta ba bzhin du gyur/ 'khor lo'i yig 'bru rnams las 'od 'phros pas/ phyogs bcu'i bde bar gshegs pa thams cad kyi thugs ka nas ye shes kyi 'khor lo dpag tu med pa spyan drangs nas bris pa'i 'khor lo la thim par gyur/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥyang yang brjod/ oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe āḥhūm̐ sogs lngas mchod/ gtor ma dang po rang gi yi dam bde kye gang yin ltar byin gyis brlabs nas 'das pa'i lha la rang rang gi cho gas dbul/ bdag gi thugs ka'i hūm̐ las 'od zer 'phros pas bsgrub bya bkug ste/ 'khor lo'i lte ba'i ming yig la thim par bsams la/ gtor ma gnyis pa sngar ltar byin gyis brlabs nas/ bde mchog ltar na mkha' 'gro spyi gtor ram/ kye rdor ltar na phyi rol pa'i cho gas 'byung po thams cad la dbul/ yig rnying du phyogs skyong la 'bul bar gsungs pas 'di gnyis la tshang ngo*// de nas yi ge brgya pa dang*/ ā li kā li brgya rtsa brgyad re bzlas te/ so so'i hūm̐ phaṭa kyi gong du/ ming 'di zhes bya ba la rak+ṣa rak+ṣaḥzhes gzhug go /de nas 'khor lo zangs sam lcags kyi thur ma la dril te la chas gtum/ gtor ma gsum pa bgegs la byin rlabs dang bsngo ba lhan cig par/ oṃ sarba bi gh+nān na maḥsarba ta thā ga te bh+yo bi shwa sogs lan gsum gyis btang la bskrad de/ 'khor lo btsun pa dang bud med kyi dpung pa g.yas dang*/ skyes pa'i g.yon du btags/ dus nam gtso la lag pa g.yas pas bkab la gong gi sngags rnams bzla'o// sgom bzlas nas 'di'i bar nyams su len pa la sgom bzlas kyi lung nges pa can thob dgos pas/ de nyid 'bog pa'i cho ga ni/ slob dpon gyi bya ba bde kye sogs kyi mngon rtogs dang 'brel ba'am/ ma 'brel ba'i tshe sgom bzlas sngar smos pa ltar bya/ gnyis pa gong ltar yang rdor sems kyi nga rgyal la gnas pas slob ma tshogs pa dang*/

sems bskyed gsal 'debs dang*/ 'dir gang gsan par bya ba'i chos ni/ rig pa 'dzin pa'i sdom ldan gyi gang zag la yan lag ma tshang ba'i ltung ba byung na/ byin gyis brlab pa dang*/ ltung ba 'phel du mi gzhug par bya ba'i phyir rdo rje sems dpa'i sgom bzlas thun gyi 'gor mdzad pa ni/ slob dpon 'jam dpal grags pas/ gal te ltung sogs byung gyur na// yi ge brgya pas byin gyis brlab// ji srid dus las ma 'das par// dag pa'i las la nyer gnas bya// 'gyod bcas nyes pa 'phel mi 'gyur// zhes gsungs pa dang mthun la/ ji ltar bya ba'i cho ga yang*/ ma rgyud kyi skabs su bde mchog gi bshad rgyud a bhi dha na dang*/ pha rgyud kyi skabs su klu byang gi dkyil mchog nyi shu pa la brten pa shas che/ 'dir snga ma'i dbang du byas na/ a bhi dha na'i le'u nyi shu rtsa lnga par/ yig brgya lha thams cad kyi gsang sngags yin tshul/ yig brgya'i sngags dngos/ de'i 'khrul 'khor gyis phyir zlog rnams gsungs la/ le'u nyi shu rtsa drug par/ ltung ba sbyong pa dang*/ ltung bshags kyi cho ga gsungs/ 'on kyang le'u de gnyis kar lha gang bsgom gsal bar ma gsungs par/ le'u drug cu rtsa bzhi pa las rdo rje sems dpa' dkar po zhal gsum phyag drug pa sogs bshad pa rnams sbyar na'ang chog mod/ gsang sngags rab 'byams kyi bdag po rje btsun sa skya pa yab sras kyis spros pa che chung 'tshams pa'i dbang du mdzad nas/ rgyud de'i le'u nyer bzhi par 'khor los sgyur ba drug gi dkyil 'khor gsungs pa'i/ rdor sems kyi dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo de zur du phyung nas cho ga 'di dang sbyar bar mdzad/ de dang mthun pa'i bzlas lung yang lam 'bras brgyud pa rnams kyi phyag bzhes su dar che mod/ lam 'bras kyi cha lag kho na yin pa'i nges pa med/ de lta bu'i cho ga sgrub pa la slob dpon gyis sgom bzlas da ci nas tshar ba yin pas/

khyed rang gi bya ba slob dpon la dpal rdo rje sems dpa' dngos yin snyam pa'i mos gus dang ldan pas bzlas lung zab mo zhu ba'i yon du maṇ+ḍal zhig mdzad par zhu/ zhes bskul la slob mas maṇ+ḍal phul/ de nas me tog dang bcas pa'i thal mo sbyar te gsol ba 'debs pa 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ sangs rgyas thams cad 'dus pa'i gtso// dpal ldan bla ma rdo rje 'chang*// khyed kyi thugs rje'i bka' drin gyis// bdag la byin gyis brlab tu gsol// zhes lan gsum brjod du gzhug dngos gzhi lung sbyin pa la gsum/ rjes su bzlas pa dang*/ dam bca' ba dang*/ byin gyis brlab pa'i lung ngo*// dang po rjes su bzlas pa'i lung gi slad du dmigs pa 'di bzhin du mdzod/ oṃ swa bhā wa sogs/ khyed rang gi phung khams skye mched rnams mi dmigs te stong par gyur/ stong pa'i ngang las pad+ma dang zla ba'i steng du/ khyed rang skad cig gis rdo rje sems dpa' sogs nas phyag rgya lngas brgyan pa dang mnyam par sbyor ba'i sku can du gsal btab nas/ slob dpon la gus 'dud drag pos gsang sngags kyi dngos grub ma lus pa stsal du gsol snyam pa'i yid kyis gsol ba btab pas/ slob dpon rdo rjes sems dpa' yab yum du gsal ba'i thugs kar zla ba'i steng du hūm̐ gi mthar mar yi ge brgya pas yongs su bskor bar bsams pa'i hūm̐ las yig brgya'i sngags phreng 'od zer dkar po 'phro ba byung*/ slob dpon gyi zhal nas thon/ khyed rang gi zhal du zhugs/ snying gar zla ba'i steng du hūm̐ dkar po bsams pa la thim/ de las bdud rtsi dpag tu med pa babs/ des ded nas/ nad gdon sdig sgrib thams cad nag nur gyi rnam pas bshang gci gnyis dang rkang mthil nas thon/ lus thams cad bdud rtsis gang bar mos la/ 'di yi rjes zlos mdzod/ yig brgya lan gsum brjod du gzhug rjes su bzlas pa'i lung ngo*// gnyis pa dam bca' ba'i lung ni/

yig brgya nyin re bzhin ma chag par bzla dgos pas/ ji tsam bzla dris khas len du gzhug de nas dus da nas bzung ste byang chub ma thob kyi bar du dpal rdo rje sems dpa' yi dam du bzung*/ yig brgya khas blangs bzhin ma chag par bzla snyam pa mdzod la/ 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ bla ma rdo rje slob dpon dgongs su gsol// bdag ming 'di zhes bgyi bas/ dus da nas bzung ste snying po byang chub la mchis kyi bar du/ dpal rdo rje sems dpa' yi dam gyi lhar bzung zhing yi ge brgya pa nyin re la nyer gcig sogs ma chag par bzla ba dam bca' lags so// zhes lan gsum brjod du gzhug dam bca' ba'i lung ngo*// gsum pa byin gyis brlab pa'i lung ni/ slob dpon la gsol ba 'debs pa'i yid kyis me tog 'thor la 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ bcom ldan bdag la stsal lags kyis// bcom ldan bdag la byin gyis rlobs// zhes lan gsum brjod/ slob dpon gyis sngags kyi dngos grub stsal zhing brtan par byin gyis brlabs par mos pa mdzod/ slob ma'i spyi bor me tog bzhag cing*// bcom ldan 'di la stsal lags kyis// bcom ldan 'di la byin gyis rlobs// zhes lan gsum brjod nas/ bcom ldan 'das dpal rdo rje sems dpas rig pa 'dzin pa 'di rnams kyi sdig sgrib nyes ltung dri ma'i tshogs thams cad byang zhing dag par byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ byin gyis brlab pa'i lung ngo*// de ltar sgom bzlas kyi lung thob phyin chad ma chag par bya snyam pas 'di'i rjes zlos lan gsum mdzod/ gtso bos ji ltar sogs lan gsum/ gtang rag gi maṇ+ḍal/ deng nas sogs spyi ltar byas la rang gnas su gtang*/ rjes chog gzhan gang yang mi dgos so// 'di ni rgyal tshab dam pa kun dga' dbang phyug gi yig cha ltar bkod pa yin gyi/ slob bshad kyi zin bris zhig la cung zad mi 'dra ba zhig 'byung mod phyag len la yod med brtag go

/de dag gis ni ma rgyud kyi phyogs gang la'ang sbyar rung gi cho ga tshang bar bshad zin to// zhar byung bde mchog gi rnal 'byor la mos pa che ba rnams kyis gong smos rdo rje mkha' 'gro'i rgyud ltar bum chog byed na/ bdag bskyed lū nag dril gsum sogs rang gtso bor gang la byed pa des bya/ mdun du bum pa bcud ldan gyi nang du so so'i dbang chog ltar/ mngon byang nas bzung rigs bdag gi rgyas 'debs pa'i bar so so'i dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo zhal phyag yongs rdzogs su bskyed pa'i zhor la bum pa'i steng gi rdo rje'i lte bar yang skad cig gis gtso bos yab yum zhig gsal gdab bo// mchod bstod bzlas dmigs bcas rang rang gzhung ltar la sngags he ru ka'i yig brgya kho na mang du bzla/ mthar mchod bstod sogs byas nas lha 'od du bzhu/ rang gzhan la khrus byed tshul sngar smos pa ltar ram bsgrub bya la byed tshe cung zad spros pa la dga' na/ sbyang ba gsum 'jug pa'i skabs bzhin bya rung ste/ de la dang po bgegs sbyang ba ni/ zhi bas sbyang ba dang*/ zhi drag phyed mas sbyang ba ni dbang chog ltar dang*/ drag po'i sbyang ba'i skabs su/ 'dir rdo rje'i slob ma rnams phyag rgya chen po'i ye shes sgrub pa la bar du gcod par byed pa'i sogs kyang 'dra/ gnyis pa sdig pa sbyang ba ni dbang chog ltar ram/ spro na/ thab tu za byed rdo rje mkha' 'gro yan lag bzhis bskyed nas mchod bstod bya/ khyed rnams kyi rkang mthil du rlung sogs kyi dmigs pa slob ma la phog ste sngags kyis til mang du dbul/ slar yang mchod bstod dang gshegs gsol bya ste/ ngor chen gyi yig cha'i steng nas byed rgyu'i rtsis yin/ 'di la gzungs dpal bas bdag bskyed kyi sngags yig brgya bzlas nas yig brgya'i sbyin sreg ces kyang gsung 'dug go /gsum pa dri ma sbyong ba ni/ slob dpon he ru kar gsal ba'i sogs nas bying rgod kyi dbang du gyur pa thams cad shān+tiṃ ku ru swā hā zhes pa'i bar gyis khrus byas la bkra shis kyi tshigs bcad ci rigs zhig brjod do// gong 'og gi khrus chog 'di gnyis ka bsgrub bya bde kye sogs rnal 'byor bla med kyi dam tshig thob pa kho na la bya rgyu yin no// rten gsum la khrus gsol na spyi ltar las 'don bya lhag po ci'ang med/

srung ma grib kyis phog nas rang la mi 'dod pa sna tshogs byung na mgon khang sogs su tshigs bcad dang yig brgya spel bas khrus gsol na legs te/ gdong bzhi pa'i dngul bre mar mgon po'i bsang ba zhes pa'i khrus chog dmigs kyis bsal ba zhig kyang yod pas so// ring nas bsags pa'i sgrib kun sbyang slad du// rigs lnga'i bdag po'i thugs rje yul nyid la/ 'jug pa'i ye shes zla zhun rnam pa ru// 'bebs pa yi ge brgya pa'i mthu kho na// de slad rgyud don man ngag gis bkral ba'i// nyams len snying por dril ba'i bsod nams rgyun// byang chub spyod pa'i rgya mtsho cher sim ste// thog mtha' med pa'i sems dpa' myur 'grub shog /ces dpal rdo rje sems dpa' he ru ka'i sgom bzlas yan lag dang bcas pa byin rlabs zla zhun gyi chu bo zhes bya ba 'di ni/ khyab bdag chos dbyings gsung gi dbang phyug rdo rje slob dpon gyi sgyu 'phrul du bzhengs pa mchog gi zhal snga nas/ dngos grub rgya mtsho'i snod du 'os pa'i skal bzang rnams kyi 'dod pa 'jo ba'i sgrub thabs kun las btus pa'i pusta kaḥgasar sgrigs grub pa'i ngo mtshar gyi ltas mo blo gros kyi rwa bar mi shong ba mngon du gyur pa'i tshe/ 'di skor lam 'bras pa la grags che yang*/ ma rgyud spyi khyab la sbyar rung gi nyer mkho yin pas na 'jug 'os sam snyam nas/ sprang btsun mdo med po wā gin+d+ra su sid+dhis 'jam dbyangs bla ma nyid kyi bsti gnas dang nye bar 'phral du bris nas phul ba byā shu bha mastu// // ༈ bal yul mchod rten rin po che bya rung kha shor gyi nye 'gram rgyal yongs sa chen zhes pa glog klad dpar khang las/ bder gshegs 7skyabs rje bco brgyad khri chen rdo rje 'chang mchog gi thugs dgongs rdzogs ched/ skyabs 'og pa tshar grwa gu rus glog klad phyag deb ched 'grem spel zhus pa'i dge 'bras sangs rgyas zhing du bsngo'o//
